metadata.title: AstralCanvas — AI horoscopes
metadata.description: Daily and weekly horoscopes assembled from pre-generated AI content, in a stylized celestial experience. For entertainment and self-reflection.

home.title: Your sky, redrawn daily
home.intro: Pick a sign, a period, and an optional focus — AstralCanvas assembles a horoscope in seconds from a library of pre-generated AI content. No waiting for a model to write live.

notice.title: AI-generated content
notice.text: All horoscopes on AstralCanvas are AI-generated and assembled from pre-generated AI-written content. They are intended for entertainment and self-reflection only, not as factual predictions or professional advice. Astrology is not scientifically established as a reliable way to predict individual events.

about.title: About AstralCanvas
about.lead: AstralCanvas is a multilingual astrology-themed web app. This page explains exactly what its horoscopes are — and are not.

how.heading: How the horoscopes are made
how.body: Every horoscope text was written with AI in advance, in separate batch runs. An algorithm assembles each reading from this stored library of AI-generated components — no AI model is called when you request a horoscope.

entertainment.heading: Entertainment, not advice
entertainment.body: Horoscopes are intended for entertainment and self-reflection. They are not factual predictions and not professional advice of any kind — medical, legal, financial, or otherwise.

science.heading: On astrology and science
science.body: Astrology is not scientifically established as a reliable method for predicting individual events. Nothing on this site should be read as a claim of predictive power.

limits.heading: Known limitations of AI content
limits.body: AI-generated text can be generic, repetitive, imprecise, or culturally awkward. We run automated checks and reviews, but imperfections remain possible.

planets.heading: About the celestial visuals
planets.body: Planets and the zodiac wheel in the app are stylized decorations and are not necessarily astronomically accurate positions for any date or place.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.body: No account is required, no birth details are collected, and no personal reading history is stored on our servers. Recently seen horoscope identifiers are kept only in your browser's local storage to avoid repeats.

footer.projectInfo: AstralCanvas — a portfolio project. Horoscopes are AI-generated entertainment.
